The screen is complete: `src/screens/Screen.tsx` and `src/screens/Screen.module.css` (score 100 on `audit_snippet`, no other files touched).

What it does:
- **Photo**: an `Avatar` plus a drop zone/`Change photo` button (mirrors the official Strata settings pattern using `DropZone`/`FileTrigger`), accepting PNG/JPEG up to 5 MB.
- **Fields**: Full name, Email, Phone, Date of birth (`DatePicker`, capped at today), Preferred language (`Select`: English, Arabic, French, Hindi, Spanish) — all with mock starting data.
- **Change tracking**: a `saved` vs `draft` state pair; each changed field shows an inline "Changed" `Badge` next to its label, and the footer reports a live count ("2 fields changed since last save" / "No changes since last save").
- **Cancel/Save**: Cancel reverts the draft to the last save; Save commits it and fires a success `toast` ("Profile updated"). Both are disabled when there's nothing to save.
- Brand-agnostic (tokens/components only), logical CSS properties, RTL-safe (email/phone forced LTR via `direction`, not `left`/`right`), and every control is named.

I can't run the dev server per your instructions, so this hasn't been visually verified in a browser — only checked against the design-system linter.
